title: A Roguelike Where Your Character Can Truly Change?
author: ChemicalLost5769
selftext:
Hiah all, I wanted to show y'all a game I've been working on for quite some time. It's called I'll Take That!, and it's a roguelike where you can take something from the corpse of any foe and add it to your own body, giving yourself various upgrades and buffs in the process! The game features real time dodging, AI generated enemies, and the ability to create custom Heros based on your own images! The game is build off of Run.game(not sponsored), and the entire thing is made with AI. From the ui, to the sprites and icons, to, of course, the code. The concept of your Hero changing as you progress has always fascinated me, and Gen AI really lets that concept flourish!

  
You can try the game out yourself right here, and the best part? It's completely free!

[https://omw.run/ill-take-that](https://omw.run/ill-take-that)
